altTexts: The practice studio underpayment scenario start
The decision step offering a top-up, a repeat payment, and abandoning the order
The safe choice explanation: pay the exact displayed difference
stepInstructions: Start the underpayment scenario: the quote was 6,906 sats and 5,000 sats were paid.
The order offers a top-up of the exact difference. Study all three options before choosing.
Choose the top-up. Paying the full quote again would overpay the order; abandoning it strands the paid sats.
